newsitem.title: FRANCE: Morocco said turning back Tunisian rights chief.
newsitem.headline: Morocco said turning back Tunisian rights chief.

text.p: The Tunisian League for the Defence of Human Rights said on Monday Moroccan police turned back its vice-president at Casablanca airport as he arrived to attend the congress of the Moroccan Human Rights Organisation.
The league, in a statement received in Paris, said police prevented Abderrahman Kraiem from phoning his embassy and placed him on a flight to Tunis last Friday.
It called the expulsion a serious breach of international conventions and urged Moroccan human rights militants to demand that their government abide by its international commitments.
